items.title: 10.22.2 Merits of the photovoltaic cell as a sustainable source of energy (lambe arse tak chalne wale energy source ke taur par photovoltaic cell ke faide) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.22.2, printed page 239.

items: Jab tak roshni maujood ho photovoltaic effect jari rehta hai, is liye yeh bijli banane ka sustainable (paidar, der tak chalne wala) tareeqa hai.
Photovoltaic system renewable (dobara milne wala) energy source hai jo sooraj ki roshni ko electrical energy mein badalta hai.
Photovoltaic systems sooraj ki energy istemal karte hain, is liye yeh fossil fuels (koyla, tel, gas) se azad sustainable energy source hain.

blocks.prompt: Photovoltaic cells ko sustainable energy source kyun kehte hain?
blocks.explanation: Inhen sirf roshni chahiye, jo sooraj se continuously (lagatar) milti hai aur khatam nahi hoti; koi fuel kharch nahi hota aur fossil fuels ki zaroorat nahi, is liye dhuan (emission) bhi nahi hota.

items: Merits (khoobiyan): roshni ho to kaam karta hai; renewable (sooraj ki roshni); fossil fuels se azad.
